items.text: It sounds like "hurry" started replaying around "{w}".
"I won't make it" feels closest, is that right?
The rush moved first, before you did.
"{w}" is circling as "what if."
A restless feeling has been going on, is that it?
The future is replaying in the present.
Something about "{w}" won't sit right with you.
The anger is still hot, is that so?
"I can't forgive this" is playing loud.
"{w}" is quietly heavy.
The sadness came before the words, didn't it?
Loss feels close, is that right?
"No one hears me" feels closest, maybe.
You've been holding this alone for a while.
Inside "{w}", it feels like being left behind.
About "{w}", a self-blame replay is running.
The "I'm sorry" is still lingering, is it?
"It was my fault" is speaking loudly.
Remembering "{w}" makes you want to disappear.
Someone's gaze is replaying right now, maybe.
"Pathetic" feels close, is that it?
"{w}" is arriving as fear.
A freezing feeling, perhaps?
You're braced for something about to happen.
Maybe the body is tired before the mind.
"I can't anymore" is replaying.
Permission to rest hasn't come, has it?
Seeing "{w}" replayed a sense of lacking.
The comparing voice is loud, is it?
Wanting it, but not having it, maybe.
Several replays are sounding at once in your head.
"Which one is true?" is the feeling, maybe.
Before sorting it out, you want quiet first.
It's a little quiet right now. Let's remember this feeling.
This is a time when the replay has paused.
This is where you really live.
You've put what you're feeling right here.
Even if it's hard to put into words, you came here.
Something is stirring, and you're noticing it.
A feeling with no name is welcome here too.
Right now, you're in the middle of noticing something.
It's okay not to put that feeling into words yet.
